title: Reliable swiping over Chat messages
summary: Horizontal navigation now starts directly on focusable Chat messages instead of silently rejecting those gestures.
changes: Horizontal page swipes can now begin directly on Chat message rows as well as on blank transcript space.
Chat messages remain keyboard-focusable and keep their long-press actions, but focusability no longer makes a message a forbidden swipe-start area.
This fixes the missed gestures visible in the touch recording where the finger moved horizontally across message text while the Chat page did not move.
Buttons, links, inputs, text areas, editable fields, vertical scrolling, the viewport-pinned page track, roster logic, Supabase data and authentication remain unchanged.
